## Real Hardware Commissioning Checklist

- [ ] Confirm E-stop path
- [ ] Confirm vendor DLL path
- [ ] Confirm EtherCAT controller power
- [ ] Confirm no axis auto-motion on startup
- [ ] Connect only
- [ ] Servo ON
- [ ] Home Z
- [ ] Home Theta
- [ ] Move Z small test
- [ ] Move Theta small test
- [ ] DO channel test
- [ ] DI sensor test
- [ ] Cylinder test
- [ ] Vacuum test
- [ ] Door test
- [ ] Short auto sequence
- [ ] Alarm/reset recovery
- [ ] Record test video

## Notes

Record machine state, operator, date/time, vendor DLL version, and any deviations from the expected behavior.
